authoritySource.detail: OAuth2 Resource Server (JWT); authorities: roles → ROLE_*, scope → SCOPE_*

nodes.mechanism: OAuth2 Resource Server (public: answers before authorization)

findings.message: On PUT /admin/employees/{id}/salary: @PreAuthorize on dev.crain.employeeservice.employee.Employee#getSalary() is skipped when dev.crain.employeeservice.employee.EmployeeResponse#from(dev.crain.employeeservice.employee.Employee) reads it: the object it reads does not come from an @AuthorizeReturnObject method or AuthorizationProxyFactory, so it is not an authorization proxy
